chunks: Al-Hasan ibn Muhammad ibn Sama'ah, from Ja'far ibn Sama'ah and Al-Hasan ibn 'Udays, from Aban, from Abd al-Rahman al-Basri, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
I asked him, 'A woman who has been divorced in a manner other than the Sunnah?' He said, 'This woman marries and is not left without a husband.'

key_terms.عَلَى غَيْرِ السُّنَّةِ: in a manner other than the Sunnah (non-standard procedure)

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling for a woman divorced outside the standard Sunnah procedure?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies that a woman divorced in a non-standard manner (khula') retains her right to remarry, ensuring she is not left in a state of perpetual singleness. This ruling underscores the Shia jurisprudential view that such divorces are valid and dissolutive, preventing the woman from remaining bound to her ex-husband indefinitely. The emphasis on her social and marital status reflects the practical concern for women's welfare within the family law framework.
